archive_size_note: Official release metadata assets is empty. No exact compressed archive size exposed; no archive downloaded. Exact source-body budget is for individually retrieved immutable raw files and excludes HTTP overhead.
scope: Conservative single-voice upstream-supported source ceiling: all standard core translation units with au_none.c, cst_mmap_posix.c and cst_file_stdio.c, SLT, usenglish, cmulex, their headers/data and COPYING. Not a proven minimum or approved integration. Extra save/load/url/audio symbols require exclusion or stubbing and retained-link verification before production integration.

build_proposal.toolchain: NDK build/cmake/android.toolchain.cmake, pinned installed version; do not run upstream Android configure unchanged
build_proposal.language: C, GNU99-compatible; no C++ runtime required
build_proposal.abi: Use project selected ABI; arm64-v8a candidate if not yet selected
build_proposal.source_selection: Explicit sources; do not glob cmulex .c files because 4 files are includes, not translation units.
guardrails: No CART_DEBUG, EXCESSIVELY_CHATTY or other debug logging macros
Do not define CST_NO_STATIC_VOX, CST_NO_STATIC_LEX or CST_NO_STATIC_LTS_MODEL
Do not add legacy ANDROID macro without deciding whether its SPEED_HACK vocoder change is desired
Use function/data sections and hidden visibility; retained-symbol inspection, not flags alone, proves no I/O
Stub or exclude logging/fatal exit/file/audio/url/load/save paths per separate path audit
Final shared library must use 16 KiB ELF alignment; NDK r28+ defaults satisfy alignment, older supported NDK needs corresponding linker options
